description: This file defines a React functional component `MCPServerView` that provides a detailed view for an MCP server, including overview, tools, and settings tabs. It includes UI elements for viewing and copying server info, toggling URL display, and editing server settings.

classes.name: MCPServerView
classes.description: React Functional Component displaying details of an MCP server with tabs for overview, tools, and settings, including copy-to-clipboard features and editing capabilities.
